## X-Sense Home Security v1.6.5

### SBS50 Security Alarms
- The alarm panel now shows `triggered` while an SBS50 intrusion alarm is active. When two sensors trigger, clearing one leaves the panel triggered until the other clears or the station confirms disarm. (#432)
- A fresh sensor status can clear an alarm when its live clear notice was missed. An older HTTP mode response no longer overrides a newer MQTT mode update.
- Existing automations using `xsense_intrusion_triggered` continue to receive the same event data.
